message.text: Landed: a class's API tab on /framework/ext/Doc/ is now one class card. The title card sits on top, then a Core API block of the heaviest members, then the class's own members, then each base class's members below (Page, then Item). Page and Item have weights; List shows the new layout with no Core API block. See /framework/core/Page/api/ and /framework/core/Item/api/; the rule is in ext/Doc/doc/class-card.md.
